newsitem.title: UK: France's Arthuis says budget to respect EMU target.
newsitem.headline: France's Arthuis says budget to respect EMU target.

text.p: Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Monday France's 1997 budget would respect the three percent deficit to gross domestic product target from the Maastricht Treaty and France would do whatever necessary to achieve it.
"The budget we will submit to the Parliament in autumn will respect this target and we will take all the decisions necessary to achieve that," Arthuis said in an interview with CNN.
CNN released extracts from the interview, due to be aired later on Monday.
Arthuis said pessimism about the economy was psychological.
"It's psychological, it's like sport. When the team is in confidence it does succeed," he said.

Arthuis said tax reforms would help bolster economic confidence. "I am pretty sure this will change (economic) behaviour. This will provide confidence and will contribute to the creation of growth, jobs and social cohesion."
France is due to present its 1997 budget on September 18.
